objects.description: During the [SolarWinds Compromise](https://attack.mitre.org/campaigns/C0024), [APT29](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0016) removed evidence of email export requests using `Remove-MailboxExportRequest`.(Citation: Volexity SolarWinds)
objects.description_fa: در طول [سازش SolarWinds](https://attack.mitre.org/campaigns/C0024)، [APT29](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0016) شواهد درخواست‌های صادرات ایمیل را با استفاده از «Remove-MailboxExportRequest» حذف کرد.[[[CTI_PRESERVE_0]] (Citation: Volexity SolarWinds)
